It sounds like you’ve found a little ritual that sets the tone for your day—nice! It still feels intentional but takes less than a minute | Ultimately, the best routine is the one that feels right for you and fits your schedule. If shaving and trimming give you that sense of readiness, keep it up! If you ever feel the time is slipping away, you can always experiment with a lighter routine or a “quick touch‑up” kit for on‑the‑go adjustments. Either way, you’re investing in a positive start to your day—nice move.
